text:
Natalie Marketplace: Quick heads-up — onboarding call with OpenWeave (model vendor) is tomorrow 10am PT. They want to list quantized variants in the cloud marketplace and allow redistributed weights in hardware partner bundles. Need legal + export check and announcement timing. Devops-bot posted calendar invite.

Lucas HW-Partner: Re: redistributed weights — do we have precedent for selling bundles with vendor-supplied quantized weights? Concern about license obligations and noncommercial clauses.

Sara Legal: We need to see their license. If it's permissive (eg. Apache/MIT) redistribution is ok; if it's custom CC or noncommercial we need explicit redistribution grant. Ask OpenWeave for a redistribution addendum or a marketplace sublicense. Also ask about attribution and model card.

Mike Partnerships: @Natalie can you add vendor contact's license file to the call notes? We should also get the advert/announce embargo window — they asked for coordinated launch but may want 2-week lead.

Anya Product: Also need benchmark artifact (latency/cost on our infra) and a small prompt set for our evals. If we can run short perf suite pre-launch we can include verified numbers in listing.

Eli Compliance: Export control question — does model use encryption or training on restricted datasets? For certain countries we may need EAR classification. Please get the training data provenance and any known restricted-country involvement.

Sara Legal: Quick checklist to request from OpenWeave:
```
- full license file
- redistribution grant or marketplace sublicense
- model card + dataset provenance
- embargo/announce date preferences
- attribution text
- support SLA for hosted variants
```

Natalie Marketplace: Copying checklist into the invite now. @Devops-bot can you paste the meeting link? :pray: 

Devops-bot: Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/abc123. Calendar invite updated.

Lucas HW-Partner: For hardware bundles, we need a small repackaging license that allows us to repackage quantized checkpoints into .rbin for shipping, with checksum and integrity statement. Can legal prepare a short template? 

Sara Legal: Yep, I can draft a short redistribution addendum. Will loop in export team. ETA EOD Wednesday.

Mike Partnerships: PR/announce logistics: propose soft launch to ecosystem partners (HW, marketplace) first week, public blog + marketplace listing in week two. Need vendor sign-off on copy. @Natalie please propose dates.

Natalie Marketplace: Proposing vendor embargo: Sept 10 internal partner preview, Sept 24 public listing + blog. Will check with vendor and report back by Tue.

Anya Product: I'll queue the perf suite for Monday run, will post results here.

Eli Compliance: Added export screening task to tracker. Will report flags by Tue.

Sara Legal: Assignments: Sara -> draft addendum; Eli -> export screen; Anya -> perf runs; Mike -> announce plan; Lucas -> hw packaging requirements; Natalie -> vendor follow-up. 

Natalie Marketplace: Thanks all. If anyone has questions ping me or drop notes in the invite. :rocket:
